hypothesis: On a card where the bank-sized mirror reserve leaves the decode mirror cache at its minimum, letting the cache grow into the bank's VRAM during decode (and releasing the least recently used mirrors when a prompt creates its bank) turns most of a token's expert uploads into hits and so decodes faster.
